it.t: Deflection Rating provides a chance to Deflect damage from Hits, preventing 40% of the damage from those Hits. Exact chance to Deflect also depends on the attacker's Accuracy.
Endgame Maps each contain a Map Boss. These Map Bosses are Unique Monsters that have special mechanics and drop increased rewards. Defeating the Map Boss will complete the Map.

Some methods of item crafting guarantee that a specific Modifier will be crafted onto the item. An item can only have one Crafted Modifier, but they otherwise behave identically to other Modifiers. Crafted Modifiers are displayed in a lighter blue colour than regular Modifiers.
Enraged is a Buff that grants 25% Toughness and 25% increased damage.

Essence monsters are powerful monsters trapped in crystallised corruption. Breaking these monsters free allows them to be defeated, dropping the Essence that can then be used to modify equipment. Any monsters with Essences Modifiers drop an additional Essence of that type.
Reviving Minions heal after avoiding damage for a short time, and automatically revive after a short delay when killed. This delay is reset whenever another Reviving Minion dies.
The Realmgate is a piece of Vaal Technology which allows the use of Atlas mechanic keys; accessing deadly areas and facing off against powerful enemies.
Thorny Ground deals Spell damage to enemies upon being created, then continues to damage enemies that move over the Ground, no more than twice per second.
